content: If additional therapeutic intervention is required, it is recommended to consider the use of SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 receptor agonists as part of the treatment strategy. In cases where the current treatment regimen has already been optimized, it is advised to reassess the patient's condition to determine whether incorporating the alternative drug class (either SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 receptor agonists) would provide a net clinical benefit, taking into account the balance of potential benefits and risks.
